requirement: The instrument is formally titled the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules,
description: The instrument is formally titled the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules,

title: Commencement Postponement Control — 2022 Amendment Chain
requirement: G.S.R. 910(E), dated 29-12-2022, postponed the commencement date specified in the 2022 amendment commencement chain from 01-01-2023 to 01-02-2023. Later commencement notifications further postponed the relevant provisions, with the operative date ultimately becoming 01-01-2024.
description: G.S.R. 910(E), dated 29-12-2022, postponed the commencement date specified in the 2022 amendment commencement chain from 01-01-2023 to 01-02-2023. Later commencement notifications further postponed the relevant provisions, with the operative date ultimately becoming 01-01-2024.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.1(2), G.S.R. 202(E), 07-03-2011

title: Act
requirement: “Act” means the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010).
description: “Act” means the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010).
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.1(2), G.S.R. 910(E), 29-12-2022; subsequent commencement postponements

title: Consumer
requirement: From 1 April 2022, “consumer” has the meaning assigned in clause (7) of section 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. This substituted the earlier Consumer Protection Act, 1986 reference.
description: From 1 April 2022, “consumer” has the meaning assigned in clause (7) of section 2 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. This substituted the earlier Consumer Protection Act, 1986 reference.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(a), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent

title: Dealer
requirement: A dealer is a person or firm carrying on the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing packaged commodities, directly or otherwise, for consideration; the definition includes a commission agent acting for a principal, subject to the manufacturer-related exclusion stated in the rule.
description: A dealer is a person or firm carrying on the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing packaged commodities, directly or otherwise, for consideration; the definition includes a commission agent acting for a principal, subject to the manufacturer-related exclusion stated in the rule.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(aa), G.S.R. 779(E), 02-11-2021; effective from 01-04-2022 under G.S.R. 779(E)

title: Industrial consumer
requirement: An industrial consumer is a consumer purchasing packaged commodities directly from a manufacturer, importer or wholesale dealer for use by the industry, with the package bearing the prescribed “not for retail sale” treatment.
description: An industrial consumer is a consumer purchasing packaged commodities directly from a manufacturer, importer or wholesale dealer for use by the industry, with the package bearing the prescribed “not for retail sale” treatment.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(b), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Institutional consumer
requirement: An institutional consumer is an institution purchasing packaged commodities directly from a manufacturer, importer or wholesale dealer for institutional use and not for commercial or trade purposes, with the prescribed “not for retail sale” treatment.
description: An institutional consumer is an institution purchasing packaged commodities directly from a manufacturer, importer or wholesale dealer for institutional use and not for commercial or trade purposes, with the prescribed “not for retail sale” treatment.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(bb), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: E-commerce
requirement: The 2017 amendment introduced the definition of e-commerce for the Rules so that the later online-listing and electronic-network requirements can be applied to transactions conducted through electronic networks.
description: The 2017 amendment introduced the definition of e-commerce for the Rules so that the later online-listing and electronic-network requirements can be applied to transactions conducted through electronic networks.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(bc), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: E-commerce entity
requirement: The 2017 amendment introduced “e-commerce entity” as the regulated online business/entity to which the e-commerce declaration obligations apply.
description: The 2017 amendment introduced “e-commerce entity” as the regulated online business/entity to which the e-commerce declaration obligations apply.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(bd), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Marketplace model of e-commerce
requirement: The 2017 amendment introduced the marketplace-model concept for e-commerce, distinguishing the model in which the online entity facilitates transactions between buyers and sellers.
description: The 2017 amendment introduced the marketplace-model concept for e-commerce, distinguishing the model in which the online entity facilitates transactions between buyers and sellers.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(be), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Lot
requirement: A lot means the total number of packages stored where packages have been stored, or the maximum hourly output of packages where packages are on or at the end of the packing line.
description: A lot means the total number of packages stored where packages have been stored, or the maximum hourly output of packages where packages are on or at the end of the packing line.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(bf), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Manufacturer
requirement: A manufacturer is a person or firm producing, making or manufacturing a commodity in packaged form, and also includes a person or firm that places or causes to be placed a mark on a packaged commodity not made by it when the mark represents the commodity as made or manufactured by that person or firm.
description: A manufacturer is a person or firm producing, making or manufacturing a commodity in packaged form, and also includes a person or firm that places or causes to be placed a mark on a packaged commodity not made by it when the mark represents the commodity as made or manufactured by that person or firm.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(c), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Maximum permissible error
requirement: Maximum permissible error means an error in deficiency in the quantity contained in an individual package which, subject to the Rules, does not exceed the limits specified in the First Schedule.
description: Maximum permissible error means an error in deficiency in the quantity contained in an individual package which, subject to the Rules, does not exceed the limits specified in the First Schedule.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(d), unchanged/definition

title: Net quantity
requirement: field: quantity_declaration required: true
description: Net quantity means the quantity by weight, measure or number of the commodity contained in the package, excluding the packaging or wrapper.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(e), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Packer
requirement: A packer is a person or firm that pre-packs a commodity, whether in a bottle, tin, wrapper or otherwise, in units suitable for wholesale or retail sale.
description: A packer is a person or firm that pre-packs a commodity, whether in a bottle, tin, wrapper or otherwise, in units suitable for wholesale or retail sale.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(f), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Principal display panel
requirement: The principal display panel is the total surface area of the package on which information required by the Rules is to be given. The information may be grouped at one place, or pre-printed information and on-line information may be grouped in separate places as permitted. LMPC Packaged Commodities Rules 2011–2026 — Corrected Rule-Engine Register Page 7
description: The principal display panel is the total surface area of the package on which information required by the Rules is to be given. The information may be grouped at one place, or pre-printed information and on-line information may be grouped in separate places as permitted. source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(g), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent

title: Medical-device declaration regime
requirement: From 23 October 2025, for packages containing medical devices, the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply to the making of the relevant declarations as provided by the inserted proviso.
description: From 23 October 2025, for packages containing medical devices, the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply to the making of the relevant declarations as provided by the inserted proviso.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(h), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Quantity
requirement: field: quantity_declaration required: true
description: Quantity means the quantity of the commodity contained in a package expressed by weight, measure or number.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(h) proviso, G.S.R. 778(E), 23-10-2025

title: Retail dealer
requirement: A retail dealer is a dealer who directly sells packaged commodities to the consumer; it also includes a wholesale dealer when that wholesale dealer makes such direct sales to consumers.
description: A retail dealer is a dealer who directly sells packaged commodities to the consumer; it also includes a wholesale dealer when that wholesale dealer makes such direct sales to consumers.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(i), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Retail package
requirement: A retail package is a package intended for retail sale to the ultimate consumer for consumption of the commodity and includes imported packages. The term ultimate consumer does not include industrial or institutional consumers for this clause.
description: A retail package is a package intended for retail sale to the ultimate consumer for consumption of the commodity and includes imported packages. The term ultimate consumer does not include industrial or institutional consumers for this clause.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(j), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent

title: Combination package
requirement: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for the package provisions that distinguish combination packages from other package types.
description: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for the package provisions that distinguish combination packages from other package types.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(k), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Group package
requirement: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for a group of packages offered together as one retail presentation.
description: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for a group of packages offered together as one retail presentation.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(ka), G.S.R. 722(E), 06-10-2023

title: Multi-piece package
requirement: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for a package containing multiple pieces of the same or different commodities as covered by the applicable Rule 6 provisions.
description: A package category introduced in the 2023 amendment framework for a package containing multiple pieces of the same or different commodities as covered by the applicable Rule 6 provisions.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(kb), G.S.R. 722(E), 06-10-2023

title: Retail sale
requirement: Retail sale means the sale, distribution or delivery of a commodity through retail shops, agencies or other means for consumption by an individual, group of individuals or another consumer.
description: Retail sale means the sale, distribution or delivery of a commodity through retail shops, agencies or other means for consumption by an individual, group of individuals or another consumer.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(kc), G.S.R. 722(E), 06-10-2023

title: Retail sale price
requirement: field: retail_sale_price required: true
description: Retail sale price means the maximum price at which the packaged commodity may be sold to the consumer. The rule prescribes the manner of printing the price, including the required inclusive-of-taxes presentation and rounding convention.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(l), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Section
requirement: “Section” means a section of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
description: “Section” means a section of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(m), unchanged/definition

title: Schedule
requirement: “Schedule” means a Schedule appended to these Rules.
description: “Schedule” means a Schedule appended to these Rules.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(n), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Standard package
requirement: A standard package is a package containing the specified quantity of a commodity.
description: A standard package is a package containing the specified quantity of a commodity.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(o), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Wholesale dealer
requirement: A wholesale dealer is a dealer who does not directly sell the commodity to a consumer, but distributes or sells it through one or more intermediaries.
description: A wholesale dealer is a dealer who does not directly sell the commodity to a consumer, but distributes or sells it through one or more intermediaries.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(p), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Wholesale package
requirement: A wholesale package includes a package containing retail packages for an intermediary, a commodity sold in bulk to an intermediary for smaller-quantity sale/distribution, or ten or more retail packages, provided the retail packages are labelled as required.
description: A wholesale package includes a package containing retail packages for an intermediary, a commodity sold in bulk to an intermediary for smaller-quantity sale/distribution, or ten or more retail packages, provided the retail packages are labelled as required.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(q), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Undefined expressions
requirement: Words and expressions used in the Rules but not defined in them, where defined in the Act, carry the meanings assigned to them in the Act.
description: Words and expressions used in the Rules but not defined in them, where defined in the Act, carry the meanings assigned to them in the Act.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(r), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Quantity/specified-package exclusion
requirement: field: quantity_declaration required: true
description: Chapter II does not apply to packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litre, subject to the stated exception for cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.Explanation (ii), G.S.R. 629(E), 23-06-2017

title: Industrial/institutional exclusion
requirement: Chapter II does not apply to packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.
description: Chapter II does not apply to packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.3(a), G.S.R. 629(E), 23-06-2017

title: Institutional consumer meaning
requirement: Explains the institutional-consumer category by reference to service institutions such as transportation, airways, railways, hotels and hospitals that buy directly from the manufacturer for institutional use.
description: Explains the institutional-consumer category by reference to service institutions such as transportation, airways, railways, hotels and hospitals that buy directly from the manufacturer for institutional use.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.2(s), G.S.R. 202(E) and subsequent amendments

title: Industrial consumer meaning
requirement: Explains the industrial-consumer category as an industrial consumer buying packaged commodities directly from the manufacturer for use by that industry.
description: Explains the industrial-consumer category as an industrial consumer buying packaged commodities directly from the manufacturer for use by that industry.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.Explanation (i), G.S.R. 629(E), 23-06-2017

title: General pre-packing and sale requirement
requirement: Structured representation of General pre-packing and sale requirement.
description: Structured representation of General pre-packing and sale requirement.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.Explanation-1, G.S.R. 722(E), 06-10-2023; G.S.R. 418(E), 29-05-2026
_a2_note: Administrative/enforcement provision — not a label declaration check.

title: Promotional retail groups
requirement: Where one or more retail packages are grouped and offered as a retail package on a promotional offer, each constituent package must comply with the applicable Rule 6 declaration requirements.
description: Where one or more retail packages are grouped and offered as a retail package on a promotional offer, each constituent package must comply with the applicable Rule 6 declaration requirements.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.4(1), G.S.R. 722(E), 06-10-2023; G.S.R. 418(E), 29-05-2026

title: Packages retained at manufacturer premises
requirement: The existence of packages at the manufacturer’s premises without a retail-sale-price declaration is not, by itself, a violation; however, every package leaving the premises for destination must carry the required retail sale price declaration.
description: The existence of packages at the manufacturer’s premises without a retail-sale-price declaration is not, by itself, a violation; however, every package leaving the premises for destination must carry the required retail sale price declaration.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.Explanation-2 clause Specific clause/proviso/explanation identified by the sub-rule, G.S.R. 418(E), 29-05-2026
_a2_note: Administrative/enforcement provision — not a label declaration check.

title: AEO bonded-warehouse declaration permission
requirement: Importers may make mandatory declarations at bonded warehouses of Authorised Economic Operator Tier-2 and Tier-3 certified operators in India, but all mandatory declarations must be present on the retail packages before those packages leave the bonded warehouse.
description: Importers may make mandatory declarations at bonded warehouses of Authorised Economic Operator Tier-2 and Tier-3 certified operators in India, but all mandatory declarations must be present on the retail packages before those packages leave the bonded warehouse.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.3(b), substituted
_a2_note: Administrative/enforcement provision — not a label declaration check.

title: Historical standard-package requirement — omitted
requirement: Historically, commodities listed in the Second Schedule had to be packed in the specified standard quantities, with the historical non-standard-pack marking proviso. Rule 5 was omitted with effect from 1 April 2022; the historical text is retained here for audit/version selection rather than treated as operative.
description: Historically, commodities listed in the Second Schedule had to be packed in the specified standard quantities, with the historical non-standard-pack marking proviso. title: Manufacturer/packer/importer identity
requirement: field: manufacturer_packer_importer_details required: true
description: The package must identify the manufacturer and, where applicable, the packer and importer with the prescribed name and address. The provision also contains rules for presumed manufacturer liability and brand-owner responsibility where names/addresses are presented in particular ways.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.5(1), G.S.R. 226(E), 28-03-2022; commencement ultimately 01-01-2024

requirement: LMPC Packaged Commodities Rules 2011–2026 — Corrected Rule-Engine Register Page 17

title: Country of origin/manufacture/assembly
requirement: field: country_of_origin_or_manufacture_or_assembly required: true
description: Imported products must carry the required country-of-origin, manufacture or assembly information under the amended declaration framework.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(a) proviso, G.S.R. 456(E), 23-06-2023

title: Common or generic name
requirement: field: common_or_generic_name required: true
description: The package must state the common or generic name of the commodity. For a package containing more than one product, the name and the number or quantity of each product must be stated.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(aa), G.S.R. 784(E), 24-10-2011; G.S.R. 137(E), 16-06-2014; G.S.R. 385(E), 14-05-2015; G.S.R.

title: Electronic-product QR — product information
requirement: For covered electronic products, specified product-identity information may be furnished through the prescribed QR-code mechanism under the amended regime.
description: For covered electronic products, specified product-identity information may be furnished through the prescribed QR-code mechanism under the amended regime.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(b), G.S.R. 784(E), 24-10-2011; G.S.R. 137(E), 16-06-2014; G.S.R. 385(E), 14-05-2015; G.S.R.

title: Net quantity
requirement: field: quantity_declaration required: true
description: The package must state the net quantity in the standard unit of weight or measure, or the number of articles where the commodity is packed/sold by number.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(b) proviso, G.S.R. 456(E), 23-06-2023

title: Month and year
requirement: field: month_year_manufacture required: true
description: The package must state the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, subject to the specified exceptions and later product-specific provisos.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(c), G.S.R. 784(E), 24-10-2011; G.S.R. 137(E), 16-06-2014; G.S.R. 385(E), 14-05-2015; G.S.R.

title: Electronic products/spare parts date placement
requirement: For electronic products, spare parts and accessories, the amended regime permits the month/year information to be supplied in the manner provided by the relevant proviso, including the QR-code mechanism where applicable.
description: For electronic products, spare parts and accessories, the amended regime permits the month/year information to be supplied in the manner provided by the relevant proviso, including the QR-code mechanism where applicable.

title: Best before/use by
requirement: Where applicable, the package must carry the prescribed best-before or use-by information. LMPC Packaged Commodities Rules 2011–2026 — Corrected Rule-Engine Register Page 20
description: Where applicable, the package must carry the prescribed best-before or use-by information. LMPC Packaged Commodities Rules 2011–2026 — Corrected Rule-Engine Register Page 20

title: Retail sale price
requirement: The package must state the retail sale price in the prescribed manner, including the maximum- retail-price presentation in Indian currency, inclusive of all taxes, subject to the rule's sectoral-law and package exceptions.
description: The package must state the retail sale price in the prescribed manner, including the maximum- retail-price presentation in Indian currency, inclusive of all taxes, subject to the rule's sectoral-law and package exceptions.

title: Dimensions where relevant
requirement: Where dimensions of the commodity are relevant, the package must state the dimensions; where pieces differ, the dimensions of each different piece must be stated.
description: Where dimensions of the commodity are relevant, the package must state the dimensions; where pieces differ, the dimensions of each different piece must be stated.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(e), G.S.R. 779(E), 02-11-2021
_a2v3_note: Dimension declarations required only for specific commodity types (textiles, containers); not a universal food/FMCG label check.

title: Electronic-product QR — dimensions
requirement: For covered electronic products, specified size/dimension information may be supplied through the permitted QR-code mechanism.
description: For covered electronic products, specified size/dimension information may be supplied through the permitted QR-code mechanism.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(f), G.S.R. 784(E), 24-10-2011; G.S.R. 137(E), 16-06-2014; G.S.R. 385(E), 14-05-2015; G.S.R.

title: Other prescribed declarations
requirement: The package must also carry any other matter that the Rules specifically require, including requirements arising under later sub-rules/provisos.
description: The package must also carry any other matter that the Rules specifically require, including requirements arising under later sub-rules/provisos.
source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, r.6(1)(f) proviso, G.S.R. 456(E), 23-06-2023

title: E-commerce mandatory declarations
requirement: An e-commerce entity must ensure that the mandatory declarations required by Rule 6 are displayed on the electronic network used for e-commerce, subject to the exceptions and conditions in the rule.

requirement: From 1 July 2026, every e-commerce entity selling imported products must provide product listings of those imported products in a searchable and sortable filter specifying the country of origin.

requirement: The unit-sale-price declaration is not required for the package categories specifically excluded by the proviso, including combination, group and multi-piece packages.

title: Consumer-care details
requirement: Every package must provide the prescribed name/address/contact information of the person or office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.
description: Every package must provide the prescribed name/address/contact information of the person or office that can be contacted for consumer complaints.

title: Restriction on individual stickers
requirement: Individual stickers cannot ordinarily be used to alter or make a declaration required by the Rules. A lower revised MRP sticker is permitted subject to the stated condition that it must not cover the original MRP declaration. LMPC Packaged Commodities Rules 2011–2026 — Corrected Rule-Engine Register Page 23
